title: Thermal treadmills: how heat variability pushes salmon to their limits
content: Just how warm is too warm? Steelhead salmon (Oncorhynchus mykiss) do not all agree—it depends on where they live. A recent study performed by the University of California, Santa Barbara (Dressler et al., 2025), reveals that a fish’s heat tolerance is shaped by the stream it calls home. However, every fish has a limit, no matter where they are from.
